context: A mom takes her young son out to a family restaurant
purpose: Teach: 鶏/調理/放題/代金/飲食/定員/ピーク/支払う

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、今日は混んでるね。ピーク時だから少し待つかも。
lines.en: Sho, it's crowded today. It's peak hours so we might wait a bit.
lines.style: Warm motherly tone, slightly apologetic, gentle and reassuring to her child

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お腹すいた!ここって食べ放題なの?
lines.en: Mom, I'm hungry! Is this place all-you-can-eat?
lines.style: Excited child voice, high pitch, eager and impatient with curiosity

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ううん、ここは普通の飲食店だよ。メニューから選ぶの。
lines.en: No, this is a regular restaurant. We pick from the menu.
lines.style: Patient explaining tone, soft and educational, calmly correcting her son gently

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあ、鶏のから揚げ食べたい!大きいやつ!
lines.en: Then I want fried chicken! The big one!
lines.style: Enthusiastic child demand, bouncy and decisive, pointing at the menu picture

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいよ。ここのお店ね、注文してから調理してくれるんだって。
lines.en: Sure. This place actually cooks it after you order, you know.
lines.style: Informative warm tone, sharing a fun fact, mother engaging child with interest

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: へえ!ねえママ、ここって定員何人くらい入れるのかな?
lines.en: Wow! Hey Mom, how many people can fit in here?
lines.style: Curious child looking around the restaurant, innocent wonder, eyes wide open

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うーん、結構入りそうだね。あ、お会計の代金はママが支払うからね。
lines.en: Hmm, looks like quite a lot. Oh, Mom will pay the bill, okay?
lines.style: Gentle motherly reassurance, casual warm tone, slight chuckle in voice softly

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: わーい!ありがとうママ、大好き!
lines.en: Yay! Thanks Mom, I love you!
lines.style: Pure childlike joy, bright and affectionate burst of happiness toward mother
